newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Ionica cover.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Ionica cover.

text.p: UK wireless telephony group Ionica Plc was rated "underperform" as Lehman Brothers started coverage of the stock, the investment bank said on Tuesday.

Lehman analysts said early results from the company were promising but the economics of targeting the residential market were challenging and its initial offering was priced at the top of the expected range.
Lehman set a year-end target of 350p on the stock, which made its market debut on July 21. By 1405 GMT Ionica shares were off 1p at 392p.
